Sanitized wire captures of codex-cli 0.165.0 (ChatGPT subscription login) talking to `https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex` through a forwarding capture proxy, with a custom model provider that sets `supports_websockets=false`. The session ran `codex exec` with the default model (`gpt-6.1-sol`) on a prompt forcing two shell tool calls. `turn1.*` is the first `POST /responses` (request body decompressed from zstd, raw SSE reply); `turn2.*` is the next request, which resends the first turn's tool call and output, and its reply. `models.response.json` is `GET /models` trimmed to 3 entries. Bearer tokens, account id, installation id, emails and local usernames and paths are replaced with placeholders, large developer-message texts are truncated, and every `sk-` is written as `sk-` (identical JSON). Encrypted reasoning blobs, if present, are kept verbatim; this capture contains none.
